entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.
2. This is an application for modification of the order dated 03.11.2023 passed in the ABLAPL.

3. Considering the submission of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the order dated 03.11.2023 passed in ABLAPL No.2370 of 2023 is hereby recalled and in its place the following order is passed - 4.

The Petitioner has filed application U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s.366/376-D/376(2)(n)/342/506, I.P.C. in connection with Soro P.S.
Case No.547 of 2022 corresponding to C.T. Case No.1167 of 2022 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C., Soro.
5.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that in the meanwhile Final Form has been submitted against accused Ranjit Singh under // 2 // Sections 366/376(2)(n)/506/363/344, I.P.C., who is stated to be the main accused.

He further submits that initially the name of the present Petitioner was not there in the F.I.R. and also he has no role in the alleged incident except the allegation of abetment constituting offences under Sections 363/366/109, I.P.C.
6.

Having regard to the submission made by the learned counsels for the parties, nature of allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the seriousness and gravity of the offences,
while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that the Petitioner if so Rajesh Ku Rout vs State Of Odisha ....

sentences.text:
Opposite Party on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72055994/
1 chooses may surrender before the learned J.M.F.C., Soro in C.T. Case No.1167 of 2022 during the first hour within three weeks from today and move for bail, and in that event the learned Magistrate shall consider the bail application of the Petitioner in the first hour of the day itself, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record.
In case of rejection of the bail application by the learned Magistrate, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in the second hour of the same day.

In that event, the higher forum shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record,
without being influenced by any observation made herein by this Court or presuming it to be a direction in affirmative.
7. The Case Diary be made available to the learned courts below as far as possible to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day itself.

The learned courts shall apply their wisdom in dealing with the application in allowing or rejecting the application for bail keeping in view the gravity of the offence and the severity of punishment.
In any eventuality the court shall verify the antecedents.
In case of any antecedents this order shall not be given effect to.
The ABLAPL and the I.A. are disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge S.K.Parida Designation: ADR-cum-ADDL.
